claim: *Coverage of model correspondence.* Mechanical checks cover only claims the representation makes decidable; semantic claims still require judgment, and unmodeled properties have no model-based coverage.

topology.description: Modeled surface contains decidable and semantic claims; unmodeled region outside; recurring miss feedback dashed.

bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: A modeled surface contains two regions: decidable claims receive mechanical checks and semantic claims require judgment. A separate unmodeled region has no model-based coverage. Dashed recurring-miss feedback calls for refining the representation or control. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
